title: Smooth Leibniz identity for τ(M, θ, ξ) with measure representations of T and ∂T (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 4.5(2), (2))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) (m+1)) and T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (m+1)) with T(η) = tauAction (m+1) M θ ξ η = ∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(η(x)) dH^{m+1}(x) for every η ∈ D^{m+1}(U). Let (μ, v) be a measure representation of T and (μ', v') one of ∂T (IsMeasureRepresentation). Let ω ∈ D^m(U) and ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞. Then ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(alternatizeUncurryFin((Dψ(x)).smulRight(ω(x)))) dH^{m+1}(x) = ∫ ψ(x)v'(x)(ω(x)) dμ'(x) − ∫ ψ(x)v(x)(dω(x)) dμ(x), where Dψ(x) = fderiv ℝ ψ x and dω = exteriorDerivative ω.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ η : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T η = tauAction (m + 1) M θ ξ η) → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (μ' : Measure (Eucl P)) (v' : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) m), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → IsMeasureRepresentation T.boundary μ' v' → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U m) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → ∫ x in M, θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((fderiv ℝ ψ x).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x))) ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) = (∫ x, ψ x * v' x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∂μ') - (∫ x, ψ x * v x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∂μ)
